headline: Palworld 1.0 legendary Pal levels
title: Palworld Legendary Pals Got Stronger | New Levels for Jetragon, Frostallion, Paladius | Palworld Guide
video_script: Palworld one point zero made the legendary Pals tougher! Frostallion, Paladius and Necromus were level fifty in early access. Now all three are level sixty. And Jetragon got the biggest change. It moved from Mount Obsidian to the Sunreach sky islands and jumped from level fifty to level seventy. So level up, bring your best team and plenty of strong spheres before you go hunting. Which legendary is your favourite? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 legendary changes: Frostallion, Paladius and Necromus went from level 50 to 60, and Jetragon moved to the Sunreach sky islands and from level 50 to 70.
